texts: Together, the displaced nightmoths keep the lanterns at the Hollows productive.

review.notes: The hard calls are all right: bare "together" makes the keeping collective (group Agent, no per-member rule), descriptive "displaced" distributes by rule instead of riding the group symbol, maintenance "keep" takes Theme + reified Still state + Result, and the plural object's flat half is correctly replaced by the (PartOf $x sk_lantern_1) rule. "the Hollows" gets the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment with no GroupOf or type atom, and the nightmoth genus is emitted with the noun modifier unexposed.
